summary_en: Studies mode-coupling mechanisms in stacked multiplex holographic acoustic lenses. Full-field simulations and experiments show that longitudinal resonances between elastic layers introduce spatial phase distortions that reduce hologram fidelity. The analysis provides design guidance for layered and conformal acoustic holographic systems, including strategies for mitigating unwanted structural-acoustic interactions.
